neighbours.label: the accrediting or ranking body of an education program: 'accredited by', 'accreditors', 'ranked by US News'; simply having lost accreditation stays quiet
fire: The school is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission.
Our nursing degree is accredited by the national nursing board.
The dean wrote reports for accreditors and visiting reviewers.
The MBA is accredited by AACSB International.
Ranked first among online colleges by US News and World Report.
The program holds accreditation from the American Psychological Association.
Regional accreditors visit the campus every ten years.
The law school is approved by the American Bar Association.
quiet: The school is located near the Higher Street market.
Our nursing home is owned by a national hotel chain.
The dean wrote letters for donors and visiting relatives.
The MBA is taught by retired bankers in the evening.
Ranked first among burger places by local food bloggers.
The program holds a picnic for new students in May.
Regional managers visit the store every ten weeks.
The law school is closed for the summer break.

notes: The + pole of this neuron is certificates (birth certificate, شهادة, сертификат), so accreditation and certification look like two sides of one area. Top examples with 'in collaboration with' are not covered.
